contracts_rationale: CI scripts, a workflow and docs only; the mission adds no service interface. The one new CLI surface (charter_pin.py attestation-note) is specified in plan.md and pinned by its unit test.
purpose_context: Epic #287 moved open-packs onto a charter release pin and a pack-check gate. This mission closes the remaining follow-ups: it records the accepted stray-file round-trip gap (#331), fixes the derived-manifest mirror's edge cases (#262), adds a warn-only attestation check and drops the write token from the step that re-derives the packs on a release bump (#310), anchors the self-binding vocabulary patterns (#304), and refreshes the epic and roadmap state.
purpose_tldr: Finish the charter release-pin work: settle the stray-file gap, close the manifest-mirror edge cases, and harden the release bump.
